ATL.note: Young core (Johnson, Daniels), hard-capped at first apron. Many expiring contracts for trade flexibility.

BOS.note: Tatum returns healthy. Hard-capped at first apron, high payroll, aiming to reset repeater tax.

BKN.note: Significant cap space for 2027, $4.5M for 2026-27. Porter Jr. extension looms. Buyers.

CHA.note: Young core (Miller), hard-capped at first apron. Good draft capital, potential buyers.

CHI.note: Hard-capped at first apron, some cap space. Acquired Claxton and Powell. Opportunistic upgrades.

CLE.note: Above second apron, high payroll with core locked. Limited trade flexibility. Repeater tax concerns.

DET.note: Young core (Cunningham, Thompson), hard-capped at first apron. Duren's extension is key. Buyers.

IND.note: Haliburton returns healthy. Hard-capped at first apron. Acquired Zubac. Looking to compete.

MIA.note: Acquired Giannis. High payroll, under luxury tax. Contenders. Waiting on Klay Thompson buyout.

MIL.note: Traded Giannis. Hard-capped at first apron with significant dead cap. Rebuilding.

NYK.note: High payroll, near second apron. Core locked. Limited flexibility; Robinson's future uncertain.

ORL.note: High payroll, above first apron, near second. Limited flexibility, traded away future firsts.

PHI.note: Strong core (Embiid, Brown, Maxey). High payroll, above tax, near first apron. Contenders.

TOR.note: Acquired Kawhi Leonard. Hard-capped at first apron. High payroll. Aiming to contend.

WAS.note: #1 pick AJ Dybantsa. Young, rebuilding team with cap flexibility.

DAL.note: Luka Doncic era. Hard-capped at first apron. Klay Thompson's expiring contract is a trade chip.

DEN.note: Established core (Jokic, Murray). High payroll, above first apron. Limited flexibility.

GSW.note: Hard-capped at second apron. Butler injured. Aging core (Curry, Green). Limited flexibility.

HOU.note: Hard-capped at second apron. High payroll (Durant, Sengun). Limited flexibility.

LAC.note: Retooling after trading Kawhi. Hard-capped at first apron. Cap flexibility, draft picks.

LAL.note: Luka Doncic era. Hard-capped at first apron. Reaves signed max. LeBron is a free agent.

MEM.note: Hard-capped at first apron. Significant cap space and large trade exception. Potential buyers.

MIN.note: Hard-capped at second apron. DiVincenzo injured. High payroll, limited flexibility.

NOP.note: Under first apron, not hard-capped. Need roster changes. Some flexibility for upgrades.

OKC.note: Young core (SGA, Holmgren, J. Williams). Above first apron, under second. Draft capital. Contenders.

PHX.note: Hard-capped at second apron. High payroll, significant dead money (Beal). Limited flexibility.

POR.note: Hard-capped at first apron. Acquired Ja Morant. Lillard returns from Achilles. Seeking consolidation trades.

SAC.note: Hard-capped at first apron. High payroll. Lack backup PG/wing depth. DeRozan's contract decision.

SAS.note: Deep young core (Wemby, Castle, Harper). Hard-capped at first apron. Prioritizing short-term deals.

UTA.note: Hard-capped at first apron. Markkanen's contract is a key trade chip. Mix of veterans and young talent.
